name: tikz-coffee-venn-command-a-plus-s3-r3
caseTitle: TikZ: a three-set coffee Venn diagram
prompt: Using LaTeX and TikZ, draw a Venn diagram of three overlapping circles labelled "Has espresso", "Has milk" and "Served cold". Write each of these drinks in the region where it belongs: short black, flat white, iced latte, iced long black, cold brew, babyccino, milkshake, pour-over.

grade.detail: short black in no circle; babyccino in no circle; flat white in Has espresso; iced latte in Served cold; cold brew crosses a circle's edge; flat white crosses a circle's edge; iced latte crosses a circle's edge; iced long black crosses a circle's edge; milkshake crosses a circle's edge; short black crosses a circle's edge
